name: National Archaeological Park Tak’alik Ab’aj
description: Tak'alik Ab'aj sits on Guatemala's Pacific slope, where a city of temples, plazas and carved stone monuments was built across nine terraces. It marks the meeting of Olmec and early Maya worlds, with giant Olmec-style sculptures alongside some of the oldest Maya hieroglyphs. Its builders also laid drains to carry water, and Indigenous visitors still come to hold ceremonies here.
